text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted Mejiro Ryan was,
I decided to take her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for your concern!
To tell the truth, I was feeling a bit tired...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, excuse me.
I'll just lie down for a little bit—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? Where am I...?

Can you hear me— Can you hear me—
This voice of mine—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wh-What?!
Where is this voice coming from...?

It's me—
Mejiro Ryan, right here—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: C-Could this be...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Inside my body...
No, deep inside my muscles...?!"

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Muscle Fibers
text_block_list.text:
Yes—I am the muscle fibers
that comprise your body—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My... muscle fibers...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Um, thank you so much!
Ever since I was little, I've always—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"For getting stronger together with me!
You're my number one partner, and...!"

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Muscle Fibers
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
I will continue to train relentlessly, each and every day...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes! I'm going to become
much, much stronger...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: From now on too—together with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah... Wh-Where am I—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, um...
It's more like... I was having a strange dream...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I... I met him!
The God of Muscles—!

I didn't quite understand what she meant...
but Mejiro Ryan seemed to be in much better spirits.

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Muscle Fibers
text_block_list.text:
Thank you...
However, Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Ryan's Muscle Fibers
text_block_list.text:
Taking a break from strength training once in a while—
to gorge oneself and sleep in all day might also be amusing—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
What?!
What did you just say...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Could my muscles really do that—
Or maybe I was holding back wanting to do it all along...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"P-Please wait...!
Lord Muscles~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ――Ah!
choice_data_list: You seemed in pain... What happened?
You seemed in pain... What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No, um... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I was having a bad dream...
What kind of dream was it again...?
It seemed Mejiro Ryan wasn't able to get a proper rest.
